role: Secondary mechanism and sampling-unit diagnostics only. They do not alter, replace, rescue or retune the frozen WFTS primary replication endpoint/comparator or three-way replication classification.
questions: If the NAAMP multi-site concentration transfers to WFTS, can measured common route-night weather account for it?
After that measured common-environment comparator, do station outcomes retain positive bounded within-taxon route-night dependence?
If dependence remains, is it confined to adjacent station numbers or retained at far route-position lags?
population: Exactly the primary WFTS-confirmatory eligible matched comparisons after the existing structural, physical-station-continuity and strictly-prior-history gates.

weather_source.product: Daymet Version 4 R1, identical to the frozen WFTS primary weather product.
weather_source.station_amounts: For each physical station and survey date, exclude survey-day precipitation and sum Daymet prcp over the 1, 3, and 7 complete local calendar days immediately preceding the survey.
weather_source.transformation: At station level use log(1 + antecedent precipitation mm).
weather_source.route_aggregation: For each window, route-run exposure is the arithmetic mean of station-level log(1 + antecedent precipitation mm) across exactly the ten permanent stations.
weather_source.rain_recency: Existing frozen mean log(1 + dry_days) route-run exposure.

species_common_environment_model.split: Existing deterministic WFTS route fold; focal routes are predicted only from the opposite fold.
species_common_environment_model.response: Calling-positive station count out of ten for each taxon x route-run.
primary_terms: cubic B-spline primary 3-day route-run precipitation exposure, 4 df
species_common_environment_model.minimum_information: At least 20 positive station cells and 5 positive routes in the training fold; otherwise common-environment shift is zero.

q_construction.site_structure: Exactly the frozen WFTS strictly-prior taxon x physical-station probability and a=0.75 drier-state persistence anchor.
q_construction.environment_shift: Cross-fitted predicted logit difference between wetter and drier route-runs for each taxon, shared across that taxon's ten stations.
q_construction.magnitude: Pair-level shift matching expected total wet incidence to observed total wet incidence.

concentration_test.conditioning: Same conditional regression on simulated route-new-taxon and total extra-station coefficients as the frozen primary comparator.

bounded_route_night_dependence.residual: e_cj = y_cj - q_cj from the fixed primary 3-day common-environment q matrices.
bounded_route_night_dependence.coefficient: rho_b = 2 * sum_c sum_{j<k} e_cj e_ck / [9 * sum_c sum_j e_cj^2]
primary_strata: all fixed-support taxon x route-night clusters
dry-route-silent taxa defined using the drier survey only
bounded_route_night_dependence.null: 1,000 independent Bernoulli draws from the same fixed heterogeneous q matrices.
bounded_route_night_dependence.support_rule: Observed rho_b exceeds the upper 95% null quantile and plus-one upper-tail P < 0.05.
bounded_route_night_dependence.decision_boundary: WFTS need not match the NAAMP magnitude to support transfer; effect size, null interval and P are reported without post-hoc threshold tuning.

route_position_lag_profile.primary_stratum: dry-route-silent taxa defined using drier outcomes only
route_position_lag_profile.coefficient: For each lag or pooled lag set, cosine correlation of residual entries e_cj and e_c,j+d across all valid within-cluster pairs.
route_position_lag_profile.null: 1,000 independent Bernoulli draws from the same q matrices.
route_position_lag_profile.primary_prediction: far pooled lags 7-9 are positive and exceed the upper 95% independent-null bound.
route_position_lag_profile.boundary: Station-number lag is route topology, not exact geographic distance.

monitoring_uncertainty.status: prospective descriptive secondary if response sample supports estimation
monitoring_uncertainty.model: Within each taxon, wet activation among station cells acoustically zero in the drier member ~ rain_contrast + temperature_difference + day_of_year_difference + year_gap + SurveyPeriod.
outputs: fraction of eligible taxa with ratio > 1
monitoring_uncertainty.boundary: Not a re-fit of a published WFTS trend estimator and not a universal correction factor.

interpretation.common_environment_sufficient: Common-environment null contains observed concentration residual within its 95% null interval.
interpretation.common_environment_insufficient: Observed concentration residual remains above its upper 95% null bound.
interpretation.route_night_positive: Bounded rho_b rejects independent station outcomes under fixed q.
interpretation.far_scale_positive: Far lags 7-9 reject independent station outcomes in the dry-route-silent stratum.
interpretation.boundary: None of these secondary diagnostics identifies social facilitation, synchronized breeding, movement, hydrological causation, or any unique lower-level mechanism.

anti_tuning: Do not alter 3-day primary precipitation window after WFTS frog outcomes are opened.
Do not select among 1/3/7-day windows by best result; 3-day is primary and 1/7-day are named sensitivities.
Do not alter route aggregation, spline df, interactions, training thresholds, q construction, simulation counts, seeds, lag bins, tails or support rules after outcome readback.
Do not change the primary WFTS replication classification based on any secondary diagnostic.
